title: 标题、对齐与通栏

title: 标题、对齐与通栏

title: 尺寸与形状对比

title: 头像组排列与溢出
explanation: 比较横向和纵向头像组，观察最大数量、重叠顺序和溢出提示。
english: Compare horizontal and vertical groups, maximum counts, stacking and overflow indicators.

title: 指示器样式与位置

title: 指示器样式与位置
explanation: 对比指示器类型和位置；切换轮播页后观察活动指示器，导航箭头和自定义指示器另行展示。
english: Compare indicator types and positions, then change slides to observe the active indicator.

title: 切换效果对比

english: Change adjacent slides to compare fade, card and slide effects independently of autoplay and input methods.

title: 切换效果对比
explanation: 在各预览中切换相邻项，比较淡入淡出、卡片与滑动效果；自动播放和输入方式不混入效果配置。
english: Change adjacent slides to compare fade, card and slide effects independently of autoplay and input methods.

title: 选项声明方式对比

english: Compare child-component declarations with options data. Both use a group model; field mapping and asynchronous data are separate.

title: 选项声明方式对比
explanation: 比较子组件声明和 options 数据声明；两种方式都使用组值，字段映射和异步选项另见对应示例。

title: 边框与分隔线

english: Compare outer borders and separators between panels, including their appearance while expanded.

title: 边框与分隔线
explanation: 比较外边框和面板间分隔线，分别展开面板观察两种装饰的边界。

title: 精度、时长与动画曲线

english: Compare final precision and the effect of duration and easing on number transitions. Manual playback remains separate.

title: 精度、时长与动画曲线
explanation: 比较小数精度对最终文本的影响，以及时长和缓动曲线对数字变化过程的影响；手动启动、暂停另行展示。
english: Compare final precision and the effect of duration and easing on number transitions. Manual playback remains separate.

title: 时间格式与自定义内容

english: Compare unit formats, milliseconds and custom time fragments, independently of playback controls.

title: 时间格式与自定义内容
explanation: 比较单位格式、毫秒显示和自定义时间片段。使用各示例中的时间字段检查最终文本，而非把精度与启动控制混在一起。
english: Compare unit formats, milliseconds and custom time fragments, independently of playback controls.

title: 弹窗尺寸与长内容

english: Open one dialog at a time to compare widths, fullscreen layouts and long-content boundaries.

title: 弹窗尺寸与长内容
explanation: 分别打开弹窗，比较宽度、全屏或长内容的可视范围；关闭当前弹窗后再打开另一种布局。
english: Open one dialog at a time to compare widths, fullscreen layouts and long-content boundaries.

title: 线条尺寸、样式与颜色
explanation: 比较线宽/缩进、线型和颜色；带文字与自定义内容保持独立，避免把插槽行为混入线条装饰。
english: Compare thickness or insets, line style and color. Text and custom content remain separate.

title: 线条尺寸、样式与颜色
explanation: 比较线宽/缩进、线型和颜色；带文字与自定义内容保持独立，避免把插槽行为混入线条装饰。
english: Compare thickness or insets, line style and color. Text and custom content remain separate.

title: 抽屉尺寸与方向
explanation: 依次打开不同抽屉，比较方向和占用空间；嵌套、挂载容器与关闭拦截另见后续案例。
english: Open each drawer separately to compare placement and occupied space. Nesting, containers and guards remain separate.

title: 空态图形与补充操作
explanation: 对比自定义图形和补充操作，观察替换默认内容与保留业务操作入口的区别。
english: Compare custom artwork and extra actions to distinguish content replacement from supplemental controls.

title: 空态图形与补充操作
explanation: 对比自定义图形和补充操作，观察替换默认内容与保留业务操作入口的区别。
english: Compare custom artwork and extra actions to distinguish content replacement from supplemental controls.

title: 标签宽度方案对比
explanation: 比较自动测量、栅格分配和固定标签宽度。用长短标签观察输入区域对齐；标签方向和校验协议保持独立。
english: Compare measured, grid-based and fixed label widths with different label lengths. Orientation and validation remain separate.

title: 标签宽度方案对比
explanation: 比较自动测量、栅格分配和固定标签宽度。用长短标签观察输入区域对齐；标签方向和校验协议保持独立。
english: Compare measured, grid-based and fixed label widths with different label lengths. Orientation and validation remain separate.

title: 图标尺寸与颜色
explanation: 比较相同图标的尺寸和颜色，旋转/动画与点击行为另行展示。
english: Compare size and color independently of rotation, animation and click handling.

title: 图标尺寸与颜色
explanation: 比较相同图标的尺寸和颜色，旋转/动画与点击行为另行展示。
english: Compare size and color independently of rotation, animation and click handling.

title: 图片说明与附加内容
explanation: 比较图片说明和附加插槽的位置；预览入口、加载和错误回退保持独立。

title: 图片说明与附加内容
explanation: 比较图片说明和附加插槽的位置；预览入口、加载和错误回退保持独立。
english: Compare caption and extra-slot placement independently of previews, loading and failures.

title: 标签输入尺寸与状态
explanation: 比较尺寸和禁用/只读/错误外观，操作可编辑实例观察标签布局；空值协议保持独立。
english: Compare sizes and disabled, read-only or error appearance while keeping the empty-value protocol separate.

title: 链接尺寸与语义颜色
explanation: 比较尺寸和语义颜色；导航目标、禁用拦截和加载反馈保留独立行为示例。
english: Compare sizes and semantic colors independently of navigation, disabled interception and loading.

title: 链接尺寸与语义颜色
explanation: 比较尺寸和语义颜色；导航目标、禁用拦截和加载反馈保留独立行为示例。
english: Compare sizes and semantic colors independently of navigation, disabled interception and loading.

title: 加载图形、尺寸与颜色
explanation: 对比相同加载状态的图形、尺寸和颜色；容器遮罩与指令用法保持独立。
english: Compare the shape, size and color of loading indicators. Container masks and directives remain separate.

title: 加载图形、尺寸与颜色
explanation: 对比相同加载状态的图形、尺寸和颜色；容器遮罩与指令用法保持独立。
english: Compare the shape, size and color of loading indicators. Container masks and directives remain separate.

title: 分组、子菜单与选项内容
explanation: 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
english: Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.

title: 分组、子菜单与选项内容
explanation: 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
english: Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.

title: 面包屑与透明表面
explanation: 比较面包屑导航和透明背景下的标题层级；完整业务内容另见独立案例。
english: Compare breadcrumb navigation and title hierarchy on transparent surfaces.

title: 面包屑与透明表面
explanation: 比较面包屑导航和透明背景下的标题层级；完整业务内容另见独立案例。
english: Compare breadcrumb navigation and title hierarchy on transparent surfaces.

title: 总数、每页条数与跳页
explanation: 比较三种分页附加能力。更改页码或每页条数时观察对应输出，数据总数与自动修正另行说明。
english: Compare total labels, page-size selection and page jumpers. Change the available controls and observe their output.

title: 总数、每页条数与跳页
explanation: 比较三种分页附加能力。更改页码或每页条数时观察对应输出，数据总数与自动修正另行说明。
english: Compare total labels, page-size selection and page jumpers. Change the available controls and observe their output.

title: 进度尺寸与状态
explanation: 在相同进度范围内比较尺寸和状态色；环形、分段和不确定进度保留独立模型。
english: Compare sizes and semantic states independently of circular, stepped and indeterminate models.

title: 进度尺寸与状态
explanation: 在相同进度范围内比较尺寸和状态色；环形、分段和不确定进度保留独立模型。
english: Compare sizes and semantic states independently of circular, stepped and indeterminate models.

title: 进度组尺寸与颜色
explanation: 比较同类分段数据的尺寸和颜色覆盖；方向、环形布局、总量溢出与键盘操作另行展示。
english: Compare segment sizes and color overrides separately from orientation, circular layouts, overflow and keyboard interaction.

title: 进度组尺寸与颜色
explanation: 比较同类分段数据的尺寸和颜色覆盖；方向、环形布局、总量溢出与键盘操作另行展示。
english: Compare segment sizes and color overrides separately from orientation, circular layouts, overflow and keyboard interaction.

title: 单选组声明方式
explanation: 比较子项与 options 声明，选择不同项观察组值；自定义字段与异步数据仍单独展示。
english: Compare child and options declarations, then select items to inspect the group model.

title: 单选组声明方式
explanation: 比较子项与 options 声明，选择不同项观察组值；自定义字段与异步数据仍单独展示。
english: Compare child and options declarations, then select items to inspect the group model.

title: 评分总数与清除
explanation: 比较评分上限和重复选择时的清除行为；半星精度、键盘输入与受控值保持独立。
english: Compare rating totals and clearing the current selection, separately from half steps, keyboards and controlled values.

title: 评分总数与清除
explanation: 比较评分上限和重复选择时的清除行为；半星精度、键盘输入与受控值保持独立。
english: Compare rating totals and clearing the current selection, separately from half steps, keyboards and controlled values.

title: 成功、警告与失败
explanation: 对比语义状态如何影响图形、标题和操作区；HTTP 状态与自定义图形另行展示。
english: Compare how semantic states affect the icon, title and actions. HTTP statuses and custom artwork remain separate.

title: HTTP 结果状态对比
explanation: 比较无权限、资源不存在和服务器错误的内容层级，按业务恢复路径选择操作文案。
english: Compare permission, missing-resource and server-error content, with recovery actions appropriate to each case.

title: 分段尺寸与禁用状态
explanation: 比较不同尺寸的密度与禁用选项的行为；受控值和块级布局保持独立。
english: Compare density at each size and disabled-option behavior.

title: 骨架内容形态对比
explanation: 比较标题/文本行与头像/卡片形态，按最终内容轮廓选择占位布局；动画和全屏加载另行展示。
english: Compare text-row placeholders with avatar and card shapes according to the final content layout.

title: 骨架内容形态对比
explanation: 比较标题/文本行与头像/卡片形态，按最终内容轮廓选择占位布局；动画和全屏加载另行展示。
english: Compare text-row placeholders with avatar and card shapes according to the final content layout.

title: 时间线方向与标签
explanation: 比较排列方向、顺序与标签位置；待完成状态和自定义节点不与布局混合。
english: Compare orientation, sequence and label placement independently of pending states and custom nodes.

title: 树节点密度与连接线
explanation: 比较节点尺寸、整行占位和连接线；选择策略、拖拽与异步子节点保持独立。
english: Compare node sizes, full-row blocks and connecting lines separately from selection, dragging and asynchronous nodes.

title: 图标、描述与分隔线
explanation: 比较单元格的前置图标、补充描述和列表分隔，按信息层级选择组合。
english: Compare leading icons, supplementary descriptions and row separators according to information hierarchy.

title: 边框与圆角对比
explanation: 比较边框、完全圆角和指定半径；动态属性与点击波纹另行展示。
english: Compare borders, fully rounded corners and explicit radii independently of live updates and ripple interaction.

title: 位置、偏移与宽度
explanation: 依次触发浮层，对比锚点方向、偏移与触发器宽度适配。关闭当前浮层后比较下一种配置。
english: Open popovers one at a time to compare placement, offsets and trigger-width fitting.

title: 水印间距、偏移与旋转
explanation: 比较水印重复间距、起始偏移和旋转角度；图片加载与全屏定位保持独立。
english: Compare repetition gaps, origin offsets and rotation independently of image loading and fullscreen positioning.

title: 主轴对齐方案对比
explanation: 比较靠右、居中和两端分布；保持相同内容数量时观察剩余空间如何分配。
english: Compare end, center and space-between alignment while observing how remaining space is allocated.

title: 点击与值变更事件
explanation: 分别点击当前项和其他项，对比点击通知与值变更通知；受控和非受控值模型另行展示。
english: Click the current and a different item to distinguish click notifications from value changes.

title: 滑块按钮与数值标签
explanation: 拖动滑块对比自定义按钮和数值标签；步长、双滑块与键盘模型保留独立场景。
english: Drag the sliders to compare custom thumbs and value labels independently of steps, ranges and keyboard models.

title: 吸附方向、偏移与容器
explanation: 分别滚动三个有边框的区域，比较顶部/底部吸附和不同偏移；每个预览独立指定滚动容器。
english: Scroll each bordered area separately to compare top/bottom affixing and offsets within an explicit scroll container.

title: 吸附方向、偏移与容器
explanation: 分别滚动三个有边框的区域，比较顶部/底部吸附和不同偏移；每个预览独立指定滚动容器。
english: Scroll each bordered area separately to compare top/bottom affixing and offsets within an explicit scroll container.

title: 时间格式与十二小时制
explanation: 比较分钟、秒和十二小时显示；注意午夜 12 AM 与中午 12 PM 的区别。值格式和步长边界仍独立展示。
english: Compare minute, second and 12-hour displays. Distinguish midnight (12 AM) from noon (12 PM); model formats and step constraints remain separate.

title: 时间格式与十二小时制
explanation: 比较分钟、秒和十二小时显示；注意午夜 12 AM 与中午 12 PM 的区别。值格式和步长边界仍独立展示。
english: Compare minute, second and 12-hour displays. Distinguish midnight (12 AM) from noon (12 PM); model formats and step constraints remain separate.

title: 范围格式与十二小时制
explanation: 比较范围的分钟、秒与十二小时制显示，操作起止端点观察格式；跨日判断和值格式独立展示。
english: Compare minute, second and 12-hour range displays and edit both endpoints. Next-day rules and model formats remain separate.

title: 范围格式与十二小时制
explanation: 比较范围的分钟、秒与十二小时制显示，操作起止端点观察格式；跨日判断和值格式独立展示。
english: Compare minute, second and 12-hour range displays and edit both endpoints. Next-day rules and model formats remain separate.

title: 周期与指定日期可用时段
explanation: 对照工作日规则与指定日期覆盖；在允许和禁止的时段分别尝试创建或编辑任务，观察完整时长的校验边界。
english: Compare recurring hours with date-specific overrides. Attempt creation or editing inside and outside available periods to inspect full-duration validation.

title: 文件类型、数量与大小
explanation: 分别选择超出大小和数量限制的本地文件，观察拒绝反馈；选择限制与请求前处理、上传队列是独立阶段。
english: Choose local files exceeding the size or count limits and inspect the rejection feedback. Selection limits are separate from request preparation and upload queues.

title: 类型与状态对比
explanation: 四种类型共享当前步骤和状态。先点击步骤或选择 1–3，再切换 wait、process、finish、error，观察 default、arrow、dot、navigation 同步更新；status 改变当前节点的语义状态，不改变步骤序号。标题与描述按页面语言显示，方便在手机宽度内对比。
english: All four types share one current-step and status model. Click a step or select 1–3, then choose wait, process, finish or error: default, arrow, dot and navigation update together. Status changes the current node’s semantic state without changing its index. Titles and descriptions follow the page language to fit the phone preview.
